note: The only file in agent-system/ that names a model. Task contracts refer to capability classes; changing a provider changes this file and nothing else.
version_change_rule: A model version change registers a NEW routing candidate. It inherits no historical trust and must be re-evaluated.

entries.scope: Architecture, invariants, phase gates, severe ambiguity
Challenger for the complex_implementation champion (openai, no adapter). Selectable only by explicit operator opt-in; never merge-eligible as a champion until promoted.

promotion_requires.rule: Registered as a NEW routing candidate under version_change_rule: it inherits no historical trust. Promotion requires a representative sample, zero critical violations and acceptable review burden under champion-challenger-v1.
